decisions.decision: Предпочесть thin common finite-binary64 statistics.mean wrapper; FED owner общий.
decisions.rationale: Exact arithmetic уже в statistics.mean3.14; fmean/fsum может переполнить сумму, median even pair использует небезопасный midpoint. Собственный корректный accumulator не объявляется дефектным, но увеличивает surface сопровождения. Для scaled RMS mean недостаточен.
decisions.cost_and_maintenance: ПроходO(n), exact integer/Fraction arithmetic; оценить цену на реальных bounded summary sizes, не переносить на traced device arrays.
decisions.qualification: Native3.14 extremes/cancellation/subnormal/permutation against independently accumulated Fraction oracle and Decimal.from_float precision1200 bounded cross-check; resource envelope; finite validation и empty policy прежние.

decisions.decision: Сохранить JAX/Equinox/Optax и текущие owner closures, исправить support semantics до AD.
alternatives: SciPy finite differences как основной gradient
where над уже вычисленной invalid loss
decisions.rationale: Ни смена framework, ни dtype не исправляют неверный estimand/support. Existing autodiff даёт единый objective для fit/Hessian. Нейтрализация входов перед nonlinear operation обязательна; scalar cond не обещает lazy vmapped ветки.
decisions.cost_and_maintenance: Compile upfront; dense HessianO(p²) storage, repeated forward cost; bounded tiny acceptance, не unlimited matrix obligation.
decisions.qualification: Pinned native eager/JIT grad/Hessian, dtype explicit, no-forward mocks; actual updates и selected-state re-evaluation.

decisions.decision: Owner CompilationCache оставить; JAX compilation cache — только дополнение после измерения.
decisions.rationale: JAX не владеет domain defaults, cancellation, generation/invalidation; гонка get→claim должна закрываться в текущем owner. Persistent cache решает другую стоимость и требует trusted storage.
decisions.cost_and_maintenance: Не повторять tracing/compile по wrapper count. Раздельно cold compilation, preparation allocation, warm execution и transfer; sync completion.
decisions.qualification: Actual backend compile instrumentation + shape/dtype/static arg matrix; gated race, cancellation/errors; no stale publication.

decisions.decision: Retain small shared signed-statistic/CV/bootstrap owner; SciPy применять по declared profile, не unconditional rewrite.
decisions.baseline: SciPy1.16.3 optional analytics/sensitivity; NumPy2.3.5; existing scipy t-test path.
decisions.rationale: Native t-test лучше собственного p-value приближения; unavailable scipy не p=0. Generic statistic callback и bounded lazy CV полезнее нового framework. BCa не percentile, time dependence не iid.
decisions.cost_and_maintenance: BootstrapO(Bn), SciPy batch controls memory; callbacks isolation and cost caps; arch adds model choice not free correctness.
decisions.qualification: Signed near-zero/constant/negative fixtures; independent hand statistics; exact seed/profile; dependent forecast intervals separate qualification.

decisions.decision: Не требовать новую библиотеку автоматически; existing exact matching owner с независимым exhaustive oracle допустим.
decisions.baseline: NetworkX3.6.1 есть lock, но не direct product runtime dependency; SciPy1.16.3 optional.
alternatives: Own exact bounded min-cost flow/augmenting paths
decisions.rationale: NetworkX снимает algorithm maintenance после явного dependency admission; exact lexicographic encoding/tie contract всё равно owner. SciPy float64 conversion может потерять low lexicographic digits. Heavy solver неоправдан для текущей задачи.
decisions.cost_and_maintenance: Existing small integer solver or NetworkXO(V³), bitwidth of lexicographic encoding учитывать. Exhaustive3×3 oracle только тестовый, production exponential search нельзя.
decisions.qualification: 729 labelled3×3 None/A/B contract cases (3^6), not all binary edge graphs, plus independent weight/tie variants, reorder invariance, actual composed chain; larger bounded cost smoke.

decisions.decision: Retain SALib1.5.2 typed adapter; поддержанные laws расширять отдельно, не снимать pending по sampler alone.
decisions.rationale: FAST analyzer ambient RNG подтверждён; bounded LOGNORMAL не unbounded lognorm. SciPy PPF reference shares implementation with SALib, значит проверяет mapping, а independent analytic/CDF controls проверяют смысл.
decisions.cost_and_maintenance: Canonical problem once per request; preserve input sample record (SALib transforms may mutate arrays/problem), local stage seeds; bounded trajectories.
decisions.qualification: Native source matrix/axes/law/profile→fresh analyzer; AB/BA whole pipeline, analytic uniform/triangular and CDF inversion controls, no claim nominal coverage from tiny fixture.

decisions.decision: Explicit PCA solver/profile и domain-separated local RNG в existing MultiOutputAnalyzer.
decisions.baseline: scikit-learn1.8.0 ml extra; NumPy SVD fallback.
decisions.rationale: Auto переключается на randomized на поддержанных больших shapes; defaultNone использует global RNG. Full small + seeded randomized large сохраняют cost/meaning. Backend/solver должны быть записаны.
decisions.cost_and_maintenance: 600×100 float64 input480000bytes; workspace отдельно. FullSVD roughlyO(np*min(n,p)), randomized bounded rank cheaper. Не universal full-SVD.
decisions.qualification: Actual600×100 rank cap5 crosses locked auto threshold; AB/BA/global-state guard; independent projector/residual, spectrum separation; persist metadata.

decisions.decision: Retain declared sampling laws/checkpoints; no arbitrary QMC upgrade or new probability framework.
alternatives: Replace interval-width heuristic by real MCSE
decisions.rationale: Sobol useful only distinct declared design; truncated/bounded law and singular joint rows not replaceable by clipped Gaussian. MCSE is a different estimator; rename heuristic now, qualify MCSE separately if needed.
decisions.cost_and_maintenance: Bound attempts, success denominator, fixed logical checkpoint schedule independent of batch; no Cartesian grid materialization.
decisions.qualification: Point mass, exact joint a−b=0, conditional failures, tail collapse vs rare positive interval; same request repartitioned into batches.

decisions.decision: Existing stdlib entry-point loader + typed producer role; no second plugin framework.
alternatives: Infer producer role from object shape
decisions.rationale: Factory product validation belongs in per-source exception boundary; public label cannot be inferred from legacy default status. Existing contracts can express this without new registry.
decisions.cost_and_maintenance: Discovery enumeration bounded by installed entry points; diagnostics safe even malformed plugin metadata; optional imports remain optional.
decisions.qualification: One valid plugin beside each broken factory; no producer mutation during read; API/CLI plot/publication branch controls.

decisions.decision: Retain existing atomic file owner, split publication and durability outcomes explicitly.
decisions.rationale: After replace, deleting referenced sidecars on later fsync error can destroy published checkpoint. Commit-state tracking fixes owner boundary; new storage would multiply migration scope.
decisions.cost_and_maintenance: JSON+sidecar IO, same-filesystem temp, directory sync platform support; no blanket all-platform acceptance for this patch.
decisions.qualification: Fault injection prewrite/prerename/postrename/dirsync; fresh reader and unrelated history survive; OS/filesystem evidence exact.

decisions.decision: Existing domain registries, fiscal mechanisms, forecast owner и source-bound scorers предпочтительнее нового general engine.
decisions.baseline: MethodRegistry/runtime view, current fiscal/plugin contracts, registered forecast adapter, existing observation/IR/CAS owners.
alternatives: Перенос float32 law в64 под видом refactor
decisions.rationale: Library не решает taxbase, estimand, supported scope или независимость evidence. Сначала сохранить выбранный economic/statistical law и вывести новые cases через typed data/contracts. Новый semantic family законно требует общего кода и новой qualification.
decisions.cost_and_maintenance: Shared integration fixture costs amortized только при precise claim mapping; unrelated product systems не подключать ради маленького patch.
decisions.qualification: Second materially different contract-compatible case, novel identifiers/axes/units, source mutation, actual fresh consumer; no causal/permission leap.
